climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: Italy's smallest wine region by size and production, an Alpine appellation around the Dora Baltea river whose vineyards are the highest in Europe. About three quarters of the wine is red, made mostly from Pinot Nero, Gamay and Petit Rouge, plus a white from Prié Blanc.
